boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named Riverwalk destinations on the Jackson Avenue and Aurora Avenue corridors immediately south and west of North Central College.

cards.title: Grand Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Jackson Avenue corridor, Naperville Riverwalk west end
cards.notes: Pause under the covered structure, use its picnic tables for a short break, and check the Park District calendar if you want to pair it with a program.
cards.short_summary: A covered Riverwalk structure with picnic tables and Park District programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The Naperville Park District’s Riverwalk map identifies Grand Pavilion on the Riverwalk’s west end as a covered structure with picnic tables.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor Riverwalk feature; follow posted Riverwalk rules.

cards.title: Horse Trough Fountain
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor, beside the Naperville Riverwalk
cards.notes: Find the black-basin fountain just off Main Street, then continue along the Riverwalk to connect a downtown walk with a historic object.
cards.short_summary: A Riverwalk fountain adapted from a former downtown horse trough.
cards.evidence_claim: The Park District’s Riverwalk map identifies Horse Trough Fountain in White Plaza and explains that its black basin was once a downtown horse trough.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public feature beside the Riverwalk; observe posted rules.

cards.title: Jaycees Playground
cards.subtitle: Jackson Avenue corridor, Naperville Riverwalk
cards.notes: Use the Riverwalk map to locate this ADA-accessible playground and combine it with a daytime walk through the adjacent park paths.
cards.short_summary: An ADA-accessible playground listed among Riverwalk highlights.
cards.evidence_claim: The Naperville Park District’s Riverwalk map describes Jaycees Playground as an ADA-accessible playground for children of all ages and abilities.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor playground; supervise children and follow posted park rules.

cards.title: Millennium Carillon
cards.subtitle: Aurora Avenue corridor, Rotary Hill
cards.notes: View the tower from Rotary Hill, then check the Park District’s details for guided-tour availability or summer concert information before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A 72-bell carillon in the 16-story Moser Tower.
cards.evidence_claim: The Naperville Park District identifies the Millennium Carillon in Moser Tower at Rotary Hill as a 16-story structure with a 72-bell instrument.
cards.source_title: Millennium Carillon in Moser Tower & Visitors Center
cards.access_notes: Outdoor viewing is available from Rotary Hill; verify tours and concerts with the Park District.

cards.title: Paddleboat Quarry
cards.subtitle: Aurora Avenue corridor, 441 Aurora Ave. near Rotary Hill
cards.notes: Check the seasonal operating details first, then rent a paddleboat, paddleboard, or kayak from the Riverwalk quarry facility if conditions allow.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal Riverwalk watercraft-rental location near Rotary Hill.
cards.evidence_claim: The Naperville Park District states that Paddleboat Quarry offers paddleboat, paddleboard, and kayak rentals at 441 Aurora Ave. near Rotary Hill.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal and weather-permitting; verify current hours and rental availability before visiting.

cards.title: Centennial Beach
cards.subtitle: Jackson Avenue corridor, 500 W. Jackson Ave.
cards.notes: Plan a summer swim visit by checking the Park District’s current operations, then use the listed amenities to decide whether the beach fits your outing.
cards.short_summary: A historic downtown swimming facility with beach-day amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Naperville Park District identifies Centennial Beach at 500 W. Jackson Ave. as a historic swimming facility with diving boards, a slide, and swimming.
cards.source_title: Paddleboat Quarry Opening Kicks Off the Summer Season on May 9
cards.access_notes: Seasonal admission facility; verify current hours, rules, and admission details with the Park District.

cards.title: Shanower Memorial
cards.subtitle: Jackson Avenue corridor, Naperville Riverwalk
cards.notes: Approach this memorial as a quiet Riverwalk stop, read the interpretive elements, and leave time to continue along the nearby linear park.
cards.short_summary: A 9/11 memorial with a 48-foot wall incorporating more than 140 faces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Park District’s Riverwalk map identifies the Shanower Memorial as a 9/11 memorial with more than 140 faces molded into a 48-foot retaining wall.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor memorial on the Riverwalk; be respectful of the commemorative setting.

cards.title: Riverwalk Amphitheater
cards.subtitle: Jackson Avenue corridor, Naperville Riverwalk
cards.notes: Use the Riverwalk map to work this named amphitheater into a walking route, and consult local event listings separately for scheduled programming.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor gathering feature on the Riverwalk map.
cards.evidence_claim: The Naperville Park District’s Riverwalk map lists the Riverwalk Amphitheater among Riverwalk highlights.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor Riverwalk feature; follow posted rules and event guidance.

cards.title: Millennium Wall
cards.subtitle: Jackson Avenue corridor, Naperville Riverwalk
cards.notes: Add this named Riverwalk feature to a self-guided walk and use the official map to connect it with the amphitheater and nearby landmarks.
cards.short_summary: A named feature on the Park District’s Riverwalk highlights map.
cards.evidence_claim: The Naperville Park District’s Riverwalk map lists Millennium Wall among Riverwalk highlights.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor Riverwalk feature; follow posted rules while visiting.

cards.title: Riverwalk Labyrinth
cards.subtitle: Jackson Avenue corridor, Naperville Riverwalk
cards.notes: Locate the labyrinth using the official Riverwalk map, then make it a deliberate pause point before continuing along the pedestrian-only paths.
cards.short_summary: A named Riverwalk feature suitable for a reflective walking stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Naperville Park District’s Riverwalk map lists the Labyrinth among Riverwalk highlights.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor Riverwalk feature; foot traffic only on Riverwalk paths.
